SourceProxy.name: SHYXVmtkOpeningCenterlines
SourceProxy.label: SHYX VMTK Opening Centerlines

Documentation.short_help: SHYX VMTK Opening Centerlines: Threshold openings, Voronoi tree or Network (punch caps).

SourceProxy.Documentation:
Single surface input. Cells whose chosen scalar magnitude is **greater than 0** are extracted (fixed threshold rule; only the array may be chosen). Each connected component defines one opening. The representative point is the mesh vertex closest to that patch centroid (for disk-like inlets/outlets).
The **Inlets (openings)** list is filled after Apply, sorted by **SurfacePointId**. Each row is keyed as **SeedPoint: <SurfacePointId>** (representative surface vertex id); identical ids get **#2**, **#3** suffixes. Check entries that are **inlets** (VMTK source seeds); unchecked openings are **outlets** (targets). Turn **Calculate centerline** on only after marking inlets so centerlines are not computed during exploration.
The **Remove openings** list mirrors the same SurfacePointId-sorted rows; checked openings are skipped on output port 1 (seed points) and excluded from centerline seeds (treated as deleted). Assign **Inlets** only among openings that remain unchecked here.
Changing **Threshold array** clears prior inlet/outlet and remove checks and rebuilds the opening list on the next Apply/update.
Output 0 is VMTK geometry when **Calculate centerline** is on. **Centerline method** **Voronoi tree** needs at least one checked inlet and one unchecked outlet among non-removed openings (closed surface; source–target tree, loops drop the cheaper arm). **Network** deletes every cell that passed the threshold (typically **EndpointIndex** caps) so each patch becomes a boundary ring, then runs vtkvmtkPolyDataNetworkExtraction (keeps loops; inlet checks are unused). Otherwise output 0 is empty.
Optional **Centerline post-process** checkboxes (only when Calculate centerline is on) run VMTK filters on port 0, in order: attributes, branch extractor, geometry.
Output 1 is one vertex per **non-removed** opening with arrays OpeningArrayValue, OpeningIndex, SurfacePointId, IsInlet; **SurfacePointId** is the active scalars array for display.
Requires VMTK compatible with this ParaView VTK (same as SHYX VMTK Centerlines).

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Vessel lumen surface with cell-centered scalars for thresholding openings (picker lists cell arrays only so the default EndpointIndex resolves to cell data when a point array of the same name also exists).

StringVectorProperty.name: ThresholdArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Threshold array
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Cell-centered array on the input (same VTK input-array slot as other SHYX filters). Default: **EndpointIndex** on **Cell Data** (e.g. vtkCGALVesselEndClipper caps). The array list is restricted to cell arrays so ParaView does not pick a same-named point array by default when both exist. Threshold rule is fixed: tuple magnitude **> 0** (not adjustable). Those cells are the opening patches (port 1 seeds). **Network** centerline method also **deletes** them from a copy of the surface so each patch becomes a geometric boundary ring.

StringVectorProperty.name: InletStatus
StringVectorProperty.label: Inlets (openings)
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: One entry per connected component after thresholding, sorted by SurfacePointId. Apply once to populate the list. Checked = inlet (VMTK source seed); unchecked = outlet (target). Names reflect threshold array magnitudes (mean per patch). Voronoi method needs at least one of each when Calculate centerline is on. Network method ignores these checks.

StringVectorProperty.name: ExcludedStatus
StringVectorProperty.label: Remove openings
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Checked openings are omitted from output seed points and from Voronoi source/target seeds (treated as deleted). They are still punched for the Network method (all Threshold cells are deleted). Unchecked openings remain available for inlet/outlet assignment.

IntVectorProperty.name: CalculateCenterline
IntVectorProperty.label: Calculate centerline
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When off (default), only seed glyphs (port 1) and the opening lists are produced. When on, runs the algorithm selected by **Centerline method**.

IntVectorProperty.name: CenterlineMethod
IntVectorProperty.label: Centerline method
IntVectorProperty.Documentation:
Voronoi tree: vtkvmtkPolyDataCenterlines on the closed input. Checked openings are sources (inlets), unchecked are targets. A vascular loop keeps only the cheaper arm.
Network: delete every cell whose Threshold array magnitude is > 0 (the same patches listed as openings, typically EndpointIndex caps on a watertight Clipper output). Remaining wall triangles have a boundary ring at each former cap. Then vtkvmtkPolyDataNetworkExtraction traces the full graph, including loops. Inlet / outlet checks are not used. Surface must have at least one hole after punching.

IntVectorProperty.name: AppendEndPointsToCenterlines
IntVectorProperty.label: Append End Points
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on (default), VMTK appends line segments from each inlet/outlet seed on the surface to the corresponding centerline endpoint (Voronoi pole). When off, centerlines stop at poles only. Voronoi method only.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: AdvancementRatio
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Advancement Ratio
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: vtkvmtkPolyDataNetworkExtraction: virtual-sphere radius = (current profile max radius) times this ratio. Must be > 1 so the sphere sticks out past the current ring and cuts the next section. Below 1 the sphere sits inside the opening, does not advance, and this filter clamps to 1. Larger values take longer strides (coarser network). Network method only. Default 1.02.

IntVectorProperty.name: ComputeCenterlineAttributes
IntVectorProperty.label: Compute attributes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: vtkvmtkCenterlineAttributesFilter on port 0. Adds point data **Abscissas** (arc length from each cell start) and **ParallelTransportNormals**. Run before **Extract branches** so abscissas continue through split tracts instead of restarting at 0 on every tract.

IntVectorProperty.name: ExtractCenterlineBranches
IntVectorProperty.label: Extract branches
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: vtkvmtkCenterlineBranchExtractor. Splits overlapping source–target paths and writes cell data **CenterlineIds**, **TractIds**, **GroupIds**, and **Blanking** (1 = bifurcation region). Intended for **Voronoi tree**. On **Network** the cells are already separate branches; this rebuilds cells and drops **Topology**.

IntVectorProperty.name: ComputeCenterlineGeometry
IntVectorProperty.label: Compute geometry
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: vtkvmtkCenterlineGeometry on the current lines (after optional split). Cell data **Length**, **Curvature**, **Torsion**, **Tortuosity**; point data **FrenetTangent**, **FrenetNormal**, **FrenetBinormal**. Applied last.
